title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 6.14
exact_target: Do Hankel determinants of univalent-function coefficients admit exponents below minus one half for all sufficiently large determinant orders? The source update answers the large-order question affirmatively.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2306014 (AMR-022-6014). CC BY 4.0.

Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory} (2018), arXiv:1809.07200. Problem 6.14, complete original question, all following updates, and the relevant chapter definitions.
